name: MCP 101 Slide Deck
description_md:
## What You Get

- A clear, conversational slide deck explaining Model Context Protocols (MCPs) in plain English.

- Insight into why MCPs matter, from enhancing AI-to-app communication to automating your digital workflow effortlessly.

- Detailed breakdowns of how MCP works at various technical levels—high, medium, and lower—for all audience types.

- Exploration of exciting opportunities, including middleware vendors, MCP servers, and emerging MCP marketplaces.
